scriptItem.scriptCode:
import os import re
import hou
chosen = hou.ui.selectFile( title="Import VGS Capture", pattern="*.vgs *.pgs", chooser_mode=hou.fileChooserMode.Read, multiple_select=True) paths = [p.strip() for p in chosen.split(";") if p.strip()]
created = [] with hou.undos.group("Import VGS Capture"): for path in paths: stem = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(hou.text.expandString(path)))[0] name = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", stem) or "capture" if name[0].isdigit(): name = "_" + name node = hou.node("/obj").createNode("vgs_capture", name) node.parm("file").set(path) node.moveToGoodPosition() created.append(node) # As Blender's import does: the scene takes the first capture's rate and length. if created: created[0].parm("fitscene").pressButton() for i, node in enumerate(created): node.setSelected(True, clear_all_selected=(i == 0))
